recText: SET-listed Origin. Completed villa 400m from Bang Tao Beach at ฿32.1M — competitive for the zone. 355–490sqm is premium family STR size. Italian-Bali design creates STR photo differentiation. Inventory available — negotiate price.

desc: 37 villas. LKF Group (HK). 5-star managed. 2008 vintage. Active resale.
recText: 16-year operating history with active resale market = maximum liquidity proof. LKF brand. 2008 land cost = structural pricing advantage vs new builds.

desc: 34 sky villas. iPad-smart. Infinity pool per unit. 10+ year STR track record. Award-winning.
recText: 10 years of verified STR income history is unmatched in catalogue. Smart tech + infinity pool per unit creates maximum STR rate. Kata zone oversupply concern — but Kata Rocks is price-tiered above mass market, largely immune.

desc: 171 units, 6 floors. World Corporation PCL (public company). Near Bangkok Hospital Siriroj. Kathu central. Completed Dec 2023.
recText: World Corporation is a public company (PCL) — audited financials, reduced default risk. ฿2.46M is lowest price in any listed-company Phuket project. Hospital proximity = stable LTR. Inland = no STR premium, but reliable occupancy.

desc: 73 units. Habitat Group. ฿148K/sqm (Kamala avg). 2027. Boutique scale improves management quality.
recText: 73-unit boutique scale is a positive differentiator. ฿148K/sqm at Kamala is at market range (KellerHenson avg). Habitat Group: verify track record — no major project data in public sources. Boutique = less developer experience, also less condo community density.

desc: 516 units. Pet-friendly. AMAL Development (different from Amal Group / Gardens of Eden). Mai Khao airport expansion zone. Large-scale building.
recText: NOTE: AMAL Development ≠ Amal Group (Gardens of Eden). 516 units at Mai Khao is large scale — verify AMAL Development's track record separately. Airport expansion upside is real. Pet-friendly = niche premium. Verify EIA and escrow before committing.

desc: 600 units. TH Group (Ayana Heights, VIP Space Odyssey). Sakhu/Nai Yang. Airport expansion zone.
recText: TH Group's parallel projects (Ayana 549 units + VIP Space Odyssey + VIP Nai Yang 600 units) raise capacity concentration risk. Verify TH Group can deliver all simultaneously. Airport zone upside genuine. ฿3M entry is compelling if delivery confirmed.

desc: 320 units. World Corporation PCL — SET-listed public company, Phuket since 2015. Rawai expat zone. LTR-focused.
recText: World Corporation PCL is a public company with audited accounts. City Phuket (Kathu, 2023) proves delivery capability. Rawai LTR demand structural. ฿3.5M+ for listed-developer Rawai condo = strong risk-adjusted entry.

desc: 37 pool villas. Wichit/Phuket Town. Mutti Development — no verifiable track record in public sources. Inland.
recText: Mutti Development has no verifiable track record in public sources (no completed projects identifiable in FazWaz, DDProperty, Lazudi, PropertyScout). Off-plan commitment to unknown developer = unacceptable risk. Inland Wichit = limited STR or premium LTR case. Avoid until developer identity and track record verified.

desc: TH Group. Rawai. 2028. From $121K (~฿4.24M). Southern coast. Long timeline.
recText: TH Group has active Phuket portfolio (Ayana 549u + VIP Nai Yang 600u + this). Concern: delivery capacity for simultaneous projects. Rawai STR strong but 2028 is long timeline — review construction milestones at 6-month intervals.

desc: 131 units. 7-floor. Kata hillside. Rooftop infinity pool. Sea+mountain views. 34 car parking. Developer not identified in public sources.
recText: Developer identity is unverified — not found in any public registry (FazWaz, DDProperty, Lazudi, PropertyScout, DBD.go.th). Unknown developer + off-plan = unacceptable risk, identical to AVOID criteria applied to #33, #102, #103. Kata hillside location is attractive but cannot compensate for unknown counterparty. Avoid until developer confirmed.

desc: Andamaya: 16yr Phuket experience. 25 units only. Hillside Bang Tao/Surin views. Sky Villa with pool. 3.5-star apart-hotel.
recText: Andamaya's 16-year experience is longest private track record in Surin category. 25-unit scale = maximum management quality per unit. Hillside views justify premium rate. Verify 3.5-star apart-hotel license status — critical for STR legal operation.

desc: California Rawai Co. Ltd. Studio–3BR. Co-working 72sqm, seaside bar, rooftop yoga. Rawai lifestyle.
recText: Lifestyle amenities (co-working, rooftop yoga) attract digital nomad LTR market. California Rawai Co. Ltd: single-project company — verify DBD registration and paid-up capital. ฿4.53M Rawai entry reasonable if delivery confirmed.

desc: Tri Property Co. (family mining group). Zcape brand. Cherngtalay. 2nd project (Zcape X1 is completed reference).
recText: Tri Property has completed Zcape X1 — this is their second project, providing some track record. Family-owned mining company background = off-core business. Cherngtalay location is strong. ฿4M entry is attractively priced for zone. Verify EIA status.

desc: 20 units, 3 floors. Patong bay panoramic views from hillside. Rooftop pool + jacuzzi. Bluepoint developer. Completed 2021.
recText: Completed 2021 = 4 years of Patong STR performance data available. Rooftop pool + panoramic Patong Bay differentiates from typical Patong condo. Concern: Patong = 4,466 unsold mid-market units (REIC). At ฿18.7M this is boutique/premium tier, somewhat protected from oversupply.

desc: Bluepoint's 2nd project. Resort concept. Mai Khao. 2026. Airport expansion zone.
recText: Bluepoint Patong (2021) provides track record. Resort concept differentiation in Mai Khao. Airport zone upside real. Small developer doing simultaneous projects — verify capacity. Request construction progress photos.

desc: 287 units. 4 buildings × 7 floors. 29.87–168.61 sqm. 1-2BR. 12,242 sqm land. Tennis court, MMA gym. Kamala.
recText: Good data available (287 units, 29–169sqm sizes). Sports amenities (tennis, MMA) create genuine lifestyle differentiation. Element Property Co. Ltd: no major track record data. 4×7-floor = substantial project for new developer — verify EIA and escrow.

desc: New Bellaguna brand from SGX-listed Banyan. Jan 2026. RAVA Beach Club — largest private beachfront club Thailand. Yacht-design architecture.
recText: SGX-listed Banyan launches new brand = institutional-grade commitment. RAVA Beach Club access is genuine differentiator (largest private beachfront club in Thailand per Banyan). 2028 timeline = full capital growth window. ฿6.8M entry for new Laguna concept.

desc: 5-storey. 1–3BR + penthouses. Concierge, restaurant, bar, spa, library, tennis. Golf membership included. Q1 2027.
recText: SGX-listed Banyan. Golf membership included = Laguna Phuket Golf top-tier access. Full concierge services command premium nightly STR rates. ฿22.34M for Laguna branded unit with full services is justified.

desc: Serviced apt concept. Bang Tao. 2026. Developer completely unidentified in any public aggregator or registry.
recText: Developer identity is completely unverified — not found in FazWaz, DDProperty, Lazudi, PropertyScout, or Thailand-Real.Estate. Off-plan serviced apartment with zero developer accountability = maximum counterparty risk. Bang Tao location alone cannot justify this risk profile.

desc: Boutique sea-view. Rawai. Developer completely unidentified. Q4 2026.

desc: 7-floor, 3 buildings. Studio–3BR. Pool, gym, kids playground, co-working. Bang Tao. Q4 2027.
recText: Bang Tao location is the primary positive. Bamboo Development: verify completed projects before committing. ฿5.5M for Bang Tao condo is below market average — either good value or pricing reflects developer credibility discount. Physical site inspection at Q4 2027 timeline is feasible.

desc: ASW pipeline Kamala — one of 6 new 2026 projects. 105-rai land bank. Pricing TBA. Details at official launch.
recText: SET-listed ASW with confirmed Kamala land bank (105 rai per Bangkok Post/ASW) is the reason to monitor this. Pricing not yet disclosed — impossible to assess value. Add to watchlist; when pricing announced, compare to ฿140–220K/sqm Kamala range.

desc: 9 ultra-luxury villas. SET-listed Siamese Asset (SA). 907+ sqm each. Thalang. Maximum scarcity.
recText: SET-listed SA provides institutional credibility. 9 units = extreme scarcity (practically irreplicable). 907+ sqm villa at ฿69–78M is below comparable Cape Panwa/Kamala branded product — relative value. Inland Thalang limits STR; lifestyle/capital growth play.

desc: JV: Ananda (SET:ANAN) + Mono + Punyisa. Cherngtalay. Mixed concept.
recText: SET-listed Ananda's Phuket push is the positive signal. JV structure with Mono/Punyisa dilutes accountability — verify which entity guarantees delivery. Cherngtalay zone is optimal. Pricing TBA makes current assessment impossible.

desc: Sansiri 3rd Kathu project. Announced Aug 2025. LTR district. Plus Property management.
recText: SET-listed Sansiri. Best entry price in any listed-developer product in Phuket. Sansiri's prior Kathu Base Bukit completed 3 months early = track record. Hospital + university = 100% occupancy rate LTR without seasonality.

desc: SET-listed Origin. Kata Beach. Pet-friendly. Off-plan launch 2026. ฿116K/sqm.
recText: SET-listed Origin. ฿116K/sqm is within Kata market range. Pet-friendly adds tenant pool. Kata heavy STR competition — Origin So brand needs to differentiate on amenity. Monitor actual pre-sales rate when launched.

desc: Nai Yang airport expansion zone. Developer unidentified in public sources. Airport 12.5→18M catalyst real.
recText: Developer identity completely unverified in all public sources. Airport expansion to 18M pax is real structural upside but identical risk profile to other AVOID-rated projects (#33, #102, #103). This upside is available through safer projects: Title Serenity Nai Yang (SET-listed ASW). Do not commit any payment until developer verified via DBD.go.th and escrow confirmed.

desc: 60 units, 7 floors. Dec 2024. Harmony Group — also Harmony Naturist Resort Rawai. Rawai expat zone.
recText: Completed Dec 2024 = zero construction risk. Harmony Group has Rawai track record (Harmony Naturist Resort). 60 units is manageable. Rawai expat LTR stable year-round. Request actual December 2024–March 2025 occupancy data before buying.

desc: SET-listed Supalai. Cherngtalay. Lagoon-themed. Residential vs resort positioning.
recText: SET-listed Supalai — most conservative listed developer. ฿3.5M in Cherngtalay is exceptional value entry (avg ฿140–220K/sqm in zone). Residential not resort focus means lower STR but higher LTR stability. Safest investment for capital preservation mindset.

desc: Botanica in Karon. Sea-view hillside villas. 2027.
recText: Botanica brand in any zone is a defensible investment. Karon sea-view hillside creates STR photo differentiation. Karon zone has supply pressure — Botanica's premium positioning insulates from mass market.

desc: Botanica Layan Phase 2. Forest concept continuation. Layan luxury zone.
recText: Phase 2 pricing typically higher than Phase 1 but Phase 1 delivery de-risks Phase 2 delivery. Botanica Layan Phase 1 delivery as reference. 2028 = full capital growth window on launch price.

desc: TITLE brand new Rawai launch. SET-listed ASW. Details at official launch event.
recText: SET-listed ASW brings zero-cancellation track record. TITLE Cielo Rawai (50m beach) sold 90%+ in week 1 — confirms Rawai STR demand. This is the follow-up. Monitor pricing when announced vs ฿100–150K/sqm Rawai range.

desc: Angsana brand. Ocean views. Private pools. Laguna. SGX-listed Banyan.
recText: SGX-listed Banyan. Angsana brand proven STR operator. ฿25.75M with ocean views + private pool in Laguna ecosystem. Laguna CAM fees typically ฿80–120/sqm/mo — verify total holding cost.

desc: SET-listed Supalai. Chalong — marinas. Completed 2023. LTR residential.
recText: SET-listed Supalai completed product. Chalong marina proximity attracts yacht owners and long-stay residents. ฿4.5M entry is conservative, yield stable year-round from expat community.

desc: Completed 2019. ฿94K/sqm. 36 sqm. Resale ฿3.39M (DDProperty Mar 2026). Rawai expat zone.
recText: Completed 2019 gives 5+ years of actual rental performance data — strongest possible due diligence. Most affordable completed Rawai condo with verified track record. Relife Co. has local presence (Harmony Naturist Resort Rawai). Request actual annual occupancy and yield data from current owners before purchasing. Best entry-level completed Rawai investment.

desc: 760 units, 8 buildings. 56% sold (Nation Thailand). ฿119K/sqm. 27–106 sqm. Pet-friendly. Q4 2027. SET-listed ASW.
recText: SET-listed ASW's largest Kata project. 56% sold at launch = demand validated. ฿119K/sqm is within Kata market range. 760 units creates resort-scale community. Pet-friendly adds STR differentiation. Q4 2027 tracks ASW's on-time delivery record.

desc: Wyndham Garden managed residences. Bang Tao. Planned 2028. Wyndham global (8,000+ hotels).
recText: Wyndham's global distribution is a strong STR asset. Private developer partner unidentified — verify before committing. Bang Tao location excellent. 2028 timeline allows thorough DD. Request franchise agreement documentation.

recText: SGX-listed Banyan, confirmed $1B pipeline. Phase I delivery will de-risk Phase II. At ฿60M+ this is lifestyle/capital preservation. Monitor: pricing and launch date when Phase I transfers complete.
